root_cause: config/keycloak/realm-choros.json's declarative user profile (KC 25.0.6 GA default, untouched by T-0734) keeps firstName/lastName required.roles:["user"]. createHumanUser (src/keycloak/admin-port.ts) never sent either field. T-0734 §5 flagged this as an out-of-scope finding, describing it as "an interactive VERIFY_PROFILE step on browser login (not a 401)" — this task's own live reproduction against t-0633-keycloak-1 found the gap is stricter: a direct grant (grant_type=password) against a user created without firstName/lastName is rejected outright with 400 invalid_grant "Account is not fully set up" — no token is issued via that path at all, not merely an extra interactive screen.
fix_summary: KcHumanUserSpec gains an optional displayName field. admin-port.ts's createHumanUser derives firstName/lastName from it via the new exported splitDisplayName() (first whitespace-separated token -> firstName, remainder rejoined -> lastName; single-token names duplicate into both fields so neither is left blank, since KC requires each independently non-empty). The split convention matches this codebase's OWN seed data precedent (migrations/016_employee.sql: e-petrov -> KC firstName="И." lastName="Петров", employee.display_name="И. Петров") rather than an invented rule. user-mgmt.ts's POST /api/users forwards the form's ALREADY-COLLECTED display_name (a required field since T-0583) as displayName — no second name-entry field added to the 'Создать учётку' form (the task's own framing: less UX friction beats a second typing pass). The placeholder/hint on that field was corrected to match the firstName-first convention. register.ts (self-registration, POST /api/register) is deliberately UNCHANGED: its display_name is literally the normalized email address (no real name is ever collected on that form), so splitting it would produce nonsense KC name values (firstName="user@company.ru"); that call site continues to omit displayName entirely, which is verified byte-identical to the pre-T-0741 payload shape by a new regression assertion in register.test.ts and admin-port.test.ts AP-8b. Self-registration's own (wider, pre-existing) version of this gap is out of scope for this task and flagged as a separate follow-up in the spec §6.
test_methodology_note: Two layers plus a live-KC leg. (1) src/__tests__/admin-port.test.ts AP-8a tests splitDisplayName as a pure function directly (no server) across the documented cases (two-token, this-codebase's-own-seed-convention match, 3+ token remainder join, single-token duplication, Latin passthrough, irregular-whitespace anti-case, empty-input anti-case). AP-8b drives createHumanUser's SUCCESS path end-to-end against a local stub HTTP server and inspects the ACTUAL JSON body sent to Keycloak (not just the port's return value) — proving firstName/lastName appear when displayName is set, and critically that they are OMITTED ENTIRELY (not sent as empty strings) when displayName is absent or blank, which is the exact shape register.ts's call site needs to stay unaffected. (2) ci/checks/db/user-mgmt.db.test.ts's existing FF-583-1 test (live Postgres :55432, InMemoryKeycloakUserPort standing in for KC) is extended with one assertion proving the REAL HTTP route (POST /api/users) forwards the request's display_name field through to the port call as displayName — this is what proves the user-mgmt.ts wiring specifically, since AP-8 only proves admin-port.ts's internal logic in isolation. (3) Before writing any code and again after, the actual KC behavioral claim (missing firstName/lastName blocks direct-grant token issuance, not just an interactive screen) was verified with raw curl against the running t-0633-keycloak-1 container: created a throwaway user without names -> direct grant 400 'Account is not fully set up'; created an equivalent user WITH firstName/lastName -> direct grant 200 with an access_token; created a third user with a single-token name (duplicated into both KC fields per the anti-case) -> direct grant also 200. All three throwaway users were deleted (best-effort cleanup) at the end of the run. This full transcript is recorded verbatim in docs/live-proof/T-0741-firstname-lastname.live-proof.md — no live-KC-required test was added to the automated CI suite; that document IS the record of the live claim, matching T-0734's own proof methodology.
